summary.text: Velma Davis is the Democratic candidate for Kansas House of Representatives District 91 in the November 3, 2026 general election.
A retired educator, she advanced from the Democratic primary on August 4, 2026.

paragraphs.text: Velma Davis earned a high school diploma from Hartford High School and a graduate degree from Emporia State University.
In a 2026 Ballotpedia survey, she said she is a retired educator with more than 30 years in Wichita Public Schools, where she worked as a teacher, counselor, librarian and technology specialist.
She said she has lived for 30 years in the area between Valley Center and Wichita in District 91.
Davis wrote in the survey that she is running to pursue accessible healthcare, affordable groceries and quality public education.
She listed health care affordability, a fair living wage, social justice, green Kansas policies and strong public schools as the policy areas she cares about most.
